title: Greenpoint Fabrication — broker rambles, pitches a number, loses it

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Hey Sam, Priya from Harbor Insurance, is Lena around?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: She's on another call. Can I take a message?

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Um, sure, or actually, um, when is she usually free?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Hold on, she just got off. Let me put you through.

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Hi Lena, so I'm calling because we work with a lot of manufacturers in Brooklyn and we've got really strong markets for property and general liability and workers comp and honestly we've been saving people like twenty percent on their premiums and I just wanted to see if you'd be open to hearing about some options because our carriers are really competitive right now and

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: How would you know that? You haven't seen my policy. Not interested.

turns.speaker: broker
turns.text: Fair, I called out of the blue. Thirty seconds, then you decide?
